name: Public S3 object read to '*' is genuinely anonymous (critical)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 101. A bare Principal '*' Allow of s3:GetObject on an S3 bucket policy is anonymous/public access in the strongest sense (S3 object reads can be made by unauthenticated HTTP clients). The generic PUBLIC-ACCESS finding is critical and carries the Block Public Access fail-closed caveat. No decoy condition is present, so the S3 per-service NOT-NARROWED note does NOT fire; the takeover rule does not fire (GetObject is a data-plane action).
